claim_tests.claim: SM8850 streaming archives reach 80 ms chunks
claim_tests.note: The separate streaming-zipformer asset named chunk-size-32 has no time unit and is excluded from the millisecond minimum.

claim_tests.claim: only offline Chinese-associated models carry -int8; parakeet, whisper, and nemotron archives do not
claim_tests.note: No-suffix archives are labeled precision=float in this manifest per the stated publication convention; archive payloads were intentionally not inspected. SenseVoice is multilingual, so Chinese-associated does not mean Chinese-exclusive.

precision_parsing.warning: The listing proves the suffix convention, not internal graph tensor dtypes. Precision=float is filename-convention metadata, not a payload inspection.

ambiguities_and_limits: The current release object schema has no assets_count field. Completeness was therefore proven by Link-header last-page discovery, derived page totals, first/last page identity checks against the embedded arrays, and unique asset IDs.

SenseVoice filenames include zh-en-ja-ko-yue. The phrase Chinese-only is valid only as a statement about which offline Chinese-associated families receive the -int8 suffix, not as a claim that every suffixed model is monolingual Chinese.
The no-suffix equals float-graph interpretation is a publication naming convention. Zero archive bodies were downloaded, so payload dtypes were not independently verified in E2.
sherpa-onnx-qnn-SM8850-binary-streaming-zipformer-transducer-zh-en-2023-03-20-chunk-size-32.tar.bz2 encodes 32 without a time unit; it is retained in chunk_size_untyped and is not described as 32 ms.

Only the asr-models-qnn-binary release body explicitly pins QNN SDK 2.40.0.251030. The -2 and -3 release bodies do not explicitly state a runtime version; E2 does not authorize pairing those contexts with any runtime.
